Synonyms tried: state court, adjudicat, court mention, mention_date, hearing, court_case, courtreminder; in all six repos. Report synonyms added: court report, processing summary, error report, OIC dashboard. No job/report summarising State Courts update processing exists. steps.step: The system counts the State Courts update records processed successfully
steps.detail: No counter/summary of adjudication processing results; the receiving process itself does not exist (OCMS26.1).

steps.step: The system records the records that failed processing, with their errors

steps.step: The system generates a summary report from the processed records and errors
steps.detail: No report generator for court updates. Existing reports (Daily/Monthly Paid, Toppan, MHA, LTA) cover other topics; the report UI ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/ has no adjudication report.

steps.step: The report is routed to the OIC dashboard
steps.detail: Dashboard.tsx has no court/adjudication report widget or feed; no mechanism routes reports to an OIC dashboard.
